claim: M3's analytic local reverse-KL IS M1's velocity MSE under a fixed timestep reweighting w(tau) ∝ (1-tau)/tau (~15x spread, emphasises late near-data steps)
how established: openpi's sample_mean_var_val makes mu affine in v with a teacher/student-shared coefficient; validated on CPU: analytic KL vs 400k-sample MC to <0.01%, gradients match elementwise; confirmed in-run (kl_weight_mean 0.713 vs theory 0.717)
caveat / what it does not license: openpi-specific. GR00T's kernel needs its own derivation. At tau=1 the closed form breaks and w must be computed numerically.

claim: Pi_RL's published flow-SDE method IS the Hybrid rollout; M3-Hybrid/M4 needed no new rollout code
how established: joint_logprob: False makes _sample_actions_with_prefix_cache draw one k per rollout call -> ODE -> one SDE transition -> ODE
caveat / what it does not license: joint_logprob: True is full SDE, a different thing

claim: M3-Hybrid does NOT broaden flow-state coverage, only environment coverage
how established: noise is injected after the step-k mean, so x_k is pre-noise and the supervised flow-state distribution equals M3's; only the executed action (and hence o_t) changes
caveat / what it does not license: so "hybrid > ode" would support "stochastic exploration in the environment helps", NOT "stochastic coverage of the denoising trajectory helps"

claim: M4 shares the score-function estimator with RLinf's OpenVLA OPD but not the object; per-element r_OPD is ~70x more accurate than the joint form at equal samples
how established: OpenVLA-OPD matches the teacher's final action distribution; M4 matches one denoising transition. compute_opd_teacher_logprobs and compute_opd_advantages are NOT reusable (OpenVLA token layout)
caveat / what it does not license: requires reward_type: action_level + logprob_type: token_level; chunk_level silently collapses to the worse estimator

claim: The flow-timestep pairing was wrong before commit 4ab7fafe and inflated teacher-student agreement ~100x
how established: chains' step axis is num_steps+1, not num_steps; velocity_mse went ~7e-4 -> 0.056-0.087, cosine ~1.000 -> 0.987
caveat / what it does not license: NOT attributable to the tau fix alone -- the rollout changed flow_noise -> flow_ode in the same window and no ablation was run

claim: Standardization: all four configs are field-for-field identical except the two axes under study
caveat / what it does not license: Sigma_tau is taken from the flow_sde closed form even for M3, whose rollout is deterministic ODE (an ODE transition has Sigma=0 and infinite KL)

claim: sync_module_states=False was an unnecessary local hack; upstream True passes with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 / NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1
caveat / what it does not license: root cause of the original FSDP-init crash is still open

claim: PRELIMINARY round (50 steps, 3 arms, M4 absent): M1 ~= M3 ~= M3-Hybrid
how established: success_at_end 0.625 / 0.681 / 0.662; all gaps <1.5 SD; within-run spread as large as between-method gaps
caveat / what it does not license: superseded by F9. Judged on success_at_end (the wrong primary metric), only 5 eval points, and M4 was missing - which is why the whole comparison was re-run.

claim: FINAL round (25 steps, all four arms re-run together after the startup bug was fixed, judged on eval/success_once): M1 ~= M3 ~= M3-Hybrid > M4
how established: mean success_once over steps 11-25: M3 0.834, M3-Hybrid 0.828, M1 0.808, M4 0.787. M1/M3/M3-Hybrid sit within ~1 SD of each other (SE of a difference 0.030); M4 is below M1 at 20 of 25 eval points and is the only arm below on both metrics.
caveat / what it does not license: one seed per arm, and the 25 eval points share the same 320 episode seeds - so cross-step consistency is consistency within one run, not independent replication. Supports 'no detectable difference among M1/M3/M3-Hybrid at this budget' and 'M4 consistently lower', not proof of either. M4 also never got the plan's required validation sweep.

how established: the whole gain happens in the first ~10 steps; an eval costs ~0.58 of a train step, so 25 steps x eval-every-1 cost LESS wall clock than 50 x eval-every-10 and gave 5x resolution
caveat / what it does not license: exposed a jump at steps 6-8, a plateau, then a late rise -- invisible at 5 eval points
